prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Perfect Desktop Companion", "Select a ready-made pet friend with unique personality traits to instantly add to your desktop."]
1: ["Preparing Your Desktop Pet Workspace", "Initializing desktop overlay engine"]
2: ["Mastering Your Desktop Companion", "Click and drag to move your pet around your desktop screens. Right-click to open interaction controls, mute, or send to system tray."]
3: ["Save Your Pet to Your Account", "Sign in to keep your new companion safe and enable seamless synchronization across your devices."]
4: ["How Would You Like to Adopt?", "Select a ready-to-play companion for instant setup or create a custom pet from your own photos."]
5: ["For optimal creation, use well-lit photos with your pet facing directly toward the camera."]
6: ["Say Hello to Your New Friend!", "Your pet is now active on your desktop screen. Give them a wave or pet them to complete onboarding!", "Wave Hello"]
7: ["Please sign in with your original account method to retain access to previously created pets."]
8: ["Feel free to minimize this app. We will send a desktop alert the moment your pet is ready!"]
9: ["Welcome to Desktop Pets", "Select your onboarding style: Quick adoption or immersive story path.", "Choose Experience"]
